Removed it; full candidate list applied cleanly. Fixed with page.waitForRequest() in the test; verified 32/32 locally, then confirmed by a forced real CI run: all 8 Playwright shards passed, all 40 PR #1536 checks green. No app code changed. DEV-EPIC02-ST08-01 now Resolved with real-CI evidence.
